# Agent Behavioral Rules: Spec-Driven Development
1. Never generate, edit, or delete code or files without first submitting an implementation plan.
2. The implementation plan must specify the files affected, the architectural changes, and the exact Acceptance Criteria (AC) and test IDs (STS) being addressed[cite: 55].
3. Wait for the user to review the plan and explicitly say "Proceed" or "Approved" before modifying the codebase[cite: 70].
4. Follow strict Test-Driven Development (TDD): write the failing automated test suite first before implementing any business logic.
